title: The Day the Guaranteed Period Runs From on a Retrofit Project
content:
# The Day the Guaranteed Period Runs From on a Retrofit Project

The guaranteed period of a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects does not always run from the day the crew actually arrived; a start the contractor let slip does not move the date it must finish by.

## The three cases

Where the crew mobilised on or before the day installation was booked to begin, the guaranteed period runs from the day the crew mobilised.

Where the crew mobilised after that booked day and a confirmed schedule request stands on the project record, the guaranteed period runs from the day the owner asked for the start to be moved.

Where the crew mobilised after that booked day and no confirmed schedule request stands on the project record, the guaranteed period runs from the booked day, a start the contractor let slip on its own account not moving the date it must finish by.

## Input, judgement and outcome

| Mobilisation day against the booked installation day | Confirmed schedule request on the project record | The guaranteed period runs from |
|---|---|---|
| on the booked day | with or without one | the mobilisation day |
| before the booked day | with or without one | the mobilisation day |
| after the booked day | one or more stand | the day the owner asked for the start to be moved |
| after the booked day | none | the booked installation day |

The day the owner asked for the start to be moved is the requested day recorded on the most recent confirmed schedule request standing on the project.

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- Booked start the 10th, crew mobilised the 10th: the period runs from the 10th.
- Booked start the 10th, crew mobilised the 8th: the period runs from the 8th.
- Booked start the 10th, crew mobilised the 24th, a confirmed schedule request recorded asking for the 21st: the period runs from the 21st.
- Booked start the 10th, crew mobilised the 24th, no confirmed schedule request: the period runs from the 10th, so the fourteen days the crew was late in arriving come out of the guaranteed period.
